item.title: Sutadoru!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Abelia
  • 発売日: 2012-01-27
  • スコア: 6.279999999999999/10 (24 人評価)
  • 日本語名: すたどる！
  • 英語名: Sutadoru!

别名

  • Stardol!

あらすじ

The protagonist is the producer of the 5-person idol group ‘Cinq Doll’ and anticipated great success for them, however the group’s popularity remained low. He was convinced that this was because there was no clear leader among the group, so he decided on a leadership competition where they will tour the country and the girl with the most fans will become the leader of the group.

item.title: Onegai♪ Goshujin-sama!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Abelia
  • 発売日: 2006-11-24
  • スコア: 6.529999999999999/10 (8 人評価)
  • 日本語名: おねがい♪ご主人さまっ！
  • 英語名: Onegai♪ Goshujin-sama!

あらすじ

Saku has taken over his grandfather’s house. It looks old but he likes it. But his grandfather’s maid says, “To take over this house, you will need to hire at least five maids.” He likes maids but he has no time. He recruits them randomly and hires five maids including a broken maid robot, his childhood friend, a sealed off devil…?
